notes.title: Achievements
notes.content: [p]What a difficult game without achievements ? So here they are. Now there are twenty two achievements available in game[/p]

notes.title: Changed second level
notes.content: [p][b]It was found that the second level has too long of an opening, where the player has to wait for some time while the character falls down without doing anything. We decided that this was too boring and redesigned the level by shortening the beginning[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619105/2f6a663ea14e467b951058fccf950b3f0acfb385.png"][/img][/p]
